name: phishredirector
description: Keeps old Phish Protection rewritten links working after you leave Phish Protection or change your rewriting domain.

PP_PUBLIC_ID.description: The **Public ID** from **Settings > Company** in Phish Protection. See [Find your values](https://github.com/duocircle/phishredirector#find-your-values).

PP_SHARED_SECRET.description: The **Shared Secret** from **Settings > Company** in Phish Protection. Click the eye icon to show it. See [Find your values](https://github.com/duocircle/phishredirector#find-your-values).
